rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
# Hack: busybox ln does not understand --relative sed -i 's@ln -sf --relative $(DESTDIR)$(SHLIBDIR)/@ln -sf @g' src/Makefile
rules.build:
if [ "$AELTRA_LIBC_NAME" = "musl" ]; then LIBFTS="-lfts" fi
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS" \ PREFIX="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ CFLAGS="$CFLAGS" \ CPPFLAGS="$CPPFLAGS" \ FTS_LDLIBS="$LIBFTS" \ PCRE_CFLAGS="-DUSE_PCRE2 -DPCRE2_CODE_UNIT_WIDTH=8" \ PCRE_LDLIBS="-lpcre2-8" \ CC="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-gcc" \ LD="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-ld" \ AS="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-as" \ AR="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-ar" \ RANLIB="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-ranlib"
rules.install: cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" mkdir -p "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" make PREFIX="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ SHLIBDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
